privacy_page_intro: This page explains what Worktime stores, who can access it, how long it is kept, and how you can export or delete your account data.
privacy_page_storage_intro: If you sign in, Worktime stores the data needed to run syncing and account-backed features.
privacy_page_storage_accounts: Account details such as your user ID, username, display name, and identity-provider subject.
privacy_page_storage_work_data: The work data you choose to save in the app, including time tracking labels, tasks, templates, work locations, Gantt tasks, time-off entries, and their sync history.
privacy_page_storage_preferences: Your synced preferences and settings data so your signed-in devices can stay in sync.
privacy_page_signin_body: Signing in is handled by an external identity provider chosen by whoever hosts your Worktime instance. Worktime never sees or stores your password — it only receives a stable account identifier, username, and display name from the provider to create and recognize your account.
privacy_page_access_you: You can access your own data through the app and export tools.
privacy_page_access_admins: App admins can access stored data when they need to support users, manage the service, or respond to abuse.
privacy_page_access_infra: Infrastructure operators who run the hosting stack may be able to access stored data while maintaining backups, databases, servers, or logs.
privacy_page_thirdparty_intro: Worktime's server talks to a small number of external services on your behalf:
privacy_page_thirdparty_identity: The identity provider used to sign you in (see “Signing in” above).
privacy_page_thirdparty_holidays: Public holiday and school holiday data is fetched from third-party holiday APIs and cached on the server. These requests only include a country code and date range — no account or personal data is sent.
privacy_page_thirdparty_errors: If the operator enables error tracking, crash and error details may be sent to a third-party error-tracking service. Personal data is not included in these reports.
privacy_page_notifications_body: The Android app can show local, on-device notifications for shift reminders, running timers, and sync status. These are generated on your device and are never sent through a push notification service, so no notification data leaves your device.
privacy_page_diagnostics_body: The server keeps request logs (method, path, status, timing, and the signed-in user ID) to operate and troubleshoot the service, plus a separate audit log for high-impact actions such as account changes and data import or export. These logs do not include request bodies or your work data.
privacy_page_retention_body: Worktime keeps account data until you delete your account or an admin removes it. Soft-deleted synced records may remain in the database until they are permanently cleaned up as part of normal maintenance.
privacy_page_rights_export: You can export your account data as JSON through the Worktime export endpoint.
privacy_page_rights_delete: You can delete your own account and its synced data at any time from Settings > Account > Danger zone. An app admin can also remove your account for you if you need help.
privacy_page_children_body: Worktime is a work-schedule tracking tool intended for use by adults in an employment context. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy_page_changes_body: This policy may be updated as Worktime evolves. Check back here periodically for the latest version.
privacy_page_contact_body: For privacy questions, contact your Worktime app admin. To delete your account and data, use Settings > Account > Danger zone, or ask an admin for help if needed.
privacy_page_tracking_body: Worktime does not show a cookie or tracking notice today because analytics are not enabled. If analytics are added later, this policy and the in-app notice will be updated.
